block.title: Hello checks its option table independently of the parser
block.p: Hello passes four long options to getopt. Checking their names, fields and return codes used to load the proof that runs the entire parser. The parser and the image check now both import the table description. An edit to the exact-match loop reaches 39 dependent files, down from 119.

The image layout now imports the record of Hello's objects directly. It takes 292 glibc interfaces to check the layout, down from 588. The read-only formatter tables and the program name offsets also have their own modules. Main's library contracts can refer to these without loading the proofs that run the formatter and select the program name.

On swa, each theorem opened once with an empty interface cache, a prebuilt worker and RQ_JOBS=12 at commits be9168624323 and 6d52d9c004de. The warm column gives the median of three more opens on the new tree. Each started a fresh worker with the interfaces already built.

The whole-program theorem still needs the parser, startup and the library implementations. Its longest import chain fell from 71 files to 41. In both runs the last prerequisite of startup assembly was the CPU image check. Generating HelloImageCpu.vos took 29.0 s on the previous tree and 26.3 s on the new tree.
